## Core Services & Practice Areas
Saleh Law specializes in helping SMEs, startups, and large construction corporations mitigate legal risks and manage disputes.

### 1. Corporate Legal Consulting & Services
- **URL:** [/services](https://saleh-lawyer.com/services)
- **Details:** Comprehensive litigation, corporate legal representation, commercial court cases, and general advisory.

### 2. Company Formation & Startup Incorporation
- **URL:** [/services/company-formation-lawyer](https://saleh-lawyer.com/services/company-formation-lawyer)
- **Details:** Incorporating Limited Liability Companies (LLC), Simplified Joint Stock Companies, drafting Articles of Association, founder agreements, and Ministry of Commerce compliance.

### 3. Commercial Contract Drafting & Review
- **URL:** [/contracts](https://saleh-lawyer.com/contracts)
- **Details:** Drafting and auditing commercial agreements to prevent future disputes.
- **Specific Contract Specialties:**
  - [/contracts/construction](https://saleh-lawyer.com/contracts/construction): Construction & EPC contracts compliant with Saudi Building Code (SBC).
  - [/contracts/partnership](https://saleh-lawyer.com/contracts/partnership): Shareholder, partnership, and joint venture agreements.
  - [/contracts/supply](https://saleh-lawyer.com/contracts/supply): Supply chain, procurement, and commercial distribution contracts.
  - [/services/construction-contracts-riyadh](https://saleh-lawyer.com/services/construction-contracts-riyadh): Specialized legal representation for contractors in Riyadh.

### 4. Commercial Debt Recovery & Execution
- **URL:** [/collections](https://saleh-lawyer.com/collections)
- **Details:** Legal debt collection, executing court judgments, payment orders, and managing bounced checks.
- [/services/debt-collection-companies](https://saleh-lawyer.com/services/debt-collection-companies): Dedicated corporate debt collection services in Riyadh.

### 5. Corporate Governance & Compliance
- **URL:** [/compliance](https://saleh-lawyer.com/compliance)
- **Details:** Structuring corporate boards, setting governance policies, managing trade licenses, and aligning with the new KSA Companies Law.
